title: Trace
description: Contract 2 (artifact), catalog row trace 1.0.2: the replay artifact of one crushing case, written by data-pipeline/pipeline/core/trace.py to data/derived/<case>/trace.json. It holds what the Python engine computed at the case's operating point: the feed and product gradations on the engine's sieve grid, the result scalars, two one-dimensional sweeps around the point (the capacity against eccentric speed, and the product size and capacity against the closed-side setting) and the classification and appearance curves. The web replays it and holds the live TypeScript engine to it. Rules the schema cannot state, checked by the producer test: sieve_mm is strictly descending and has one more value than mid_mm; feed_passing and product_passing have the length of sieve_mm, lie in [0, 1] and do not increase along the grid; each sweep's arrays have the same length; summary equals the case manifest's metrics.

case_id.description: The case identifier, the same as its manifest's.

sieve_mm.description: Sieve aperture edges, coarse to fine (the engine grid: 256 mm, square-root-of-two series, 29 edges) [mm].

mid_mm.description: Geometric mid-size of each size class [mm].

feed_passing.description: Feed cumulative fraction passing at each edge [fraction].

product_passing.description: Product cumulative fraction passing at each edge [fraction].

feed_mass.description: Feed mass fraction in each class (sums to 1) [fraction].

product_mass.description: Product mass fraction in each class (sums to 1 within the mass-closure tolerance) [fraction].

classification.description: Whiten classification function C(d) at each class mid-size: the probability a particle of that size is selected for breakage [fraction].

appearance_t10.description: The t10 of the breakage appearance function used: the fraction of the progeny passing one tenth of the parent size, in [0, 0.44] (the engine caps it at 0.44) [fraction].

f80_mm.description: Feed 80 percent passing size on the engine grid [mm].

pct_passing.description: Product fraction passing at 1, 4, 8, 16 and 32 mm, keyed by the size [fraction].

throughput_tph.description: Capacity of the machine at the operating point [t/h].

oss_mm.description: Open-side setting, the closed-side setting plus the throw [mm].

nip_angle_deg.description: Nip angle between the mantle and the concave (or the jaws) at the setting [deg].

nip_limit_deg.description: Grip limit 2 arctan(mu) of the nip angle [deg].

regime.description: The operating regime: choke, trickle, pass-through (setting at or above F80, or a reduction ratio near one) or invalid (setting at or above the feed's top size).

valid.description: False when the point is not valid: nothing gripped, an ill-conditioned breakage matrix or a physically implausible input.

out_of_envelope.description: True when any envelope check tripped (an implausible or an extrapolating input).

implausible.description: True for a physically nonsensical input, worse than an extrapolation.

mass_closure.description: The absolute difference between the summed product and feed mass fractions, about 0 [fraction].

cond_estimate.description: Conditioning proxy of (I - B C); the string Infinity when the solve is singular.

summary.description: The result scalars of the engine at the case's operating point.

speed_sweep.description: The capacity hump: the engine at the case's point with only the eccentric speed varied over the machine's range.

speed_rpm.description: The eccentric speeds of the sweep [rpm].

throughput_tph.description: The throughput at each speed; 0 where the engine cannot evaluate the point [t/h].

power_kw.description: The power at each speed; 0 where the engine cannot evaluate the point [kW].

css_sweep.description: The setting trade-off: the engine at the case's point with only the closed-side setting varied.

css_mm.description: The closed-side settings of the sweep [mm].

p80_mm.description: The product P80 at each setting; 0 where the engine cannot evaluate the point [mm].

throughput_tph.description: The throughput at each setting; 0 where the engine cannot evaluate the point [t/h].

power_kw.description: The power at each setting; 0 where the engine cannot evaluate the point [kW].
